newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne gas oil exports fell in April.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne gas oil exports fell in April.

text.p: Seaborne exports of Russian gas oil from the Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk, Tuapse and Odessa and the Baltic port of Ventspils fell by 32 percent in April, shipping inspectors Petrak said on Thursday.
Gas oil exports from the four ports totalled 1.33 million tonnes in April compared with 1.96 million tonnes in March.

The decline was caused by a steep fall in exports from Odessa in the Black Sea and Ventspils in the Baltic. Odessa exports in April were 112,410 tonnes compared with 407,000 tonnes in March while Ventspils exported 689,700 tonnes against 1.09 million.
Exports from the ports of Novorossiisk and Tuapse rose, but not enough to counter the drops from the other two outlets.
Novorossiisk exported 182,820 tonnes in April compared with 147,000 tonnes in March while Tuapse exported 345,600 tonnes compared with 318,000 tonnes.
